title: Randomized Weighted Distance Nearest Neighbor Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.29720v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The nearest neighbor classifier is known to be memory-inefficient, and a popular solution is to compress its training data. Recently, a compression algorithm based on weighted distance nearest neighbor (WNN) was proposed, which has elegant theoretical properties and effective classification performance. However, its compression process is computationally expensive, for it performs a greedy search of the densest homogeneous balls in data space. In this paper, we propose a randomized variant RWNN. It simply randomizes the ball search process, and results in substantially reduced compression time (often 0.1%--1% of WNN's) and similar classification accuracy. RWNN also inherits several theoretical properties of WNN including consistency and a generalization bound. Experimental results on multiple datasets demonstrate its efficacy.

translated_title: 随机化加权距离最近邻分类
translated_abstract: 众所周知，最近邻分类器的内存效率低下，一种流行的解决方案是压缩其训练数据。最近，一种基于加权距离最近邻（WNN）的压缩算法被提出，该算法具有优美的理论性质和有效的分类性能。然而，其压缩过程计算代价高昂，因为它需要在数据空间中对最稠密的同质球进行贪婪搜索。本文提出了一个随机化变体RWNN，它仅将球搜索过程随机化，从而大幅减少了压缩时间（通常仅为WNN的0.1%--1%），同时保持了相似的分类精度。RWNN还继承了WNN的若干理论性质，包括一致性和泛化界。在多个数据集上的实验结果证明了其有效性。
tldr: 本文提出随机化加权距离最近邻分类器RWNN，通过将最稠密同质球的贪婪搜索过程随机化，将压缩时间大幅降至WNN的0.1%--1%，同时保持相近的分类精度并继承一致性与泛化界等理论性质。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RWNN, a randomized variant of the weighted distance nearest neighbor classifier, which randomizes the greedy ball search process to reduce compression time to only 0.1%--1% of WNN's while achieving similar classification accuracy and inheriting theoretical properties such as consistency and a generalization bound.
